name: Tissue-type segmentation
summary: Generates a five-tissue-type (5TT) image from a T1-weighted image with MRtrix3 5ttgen fsl, plus binarized gray matter, white matter and CSF masks, for anatomically-constrained tractography.
description: Runs 5ttgen fsl (FSL BET, FAST and FIRST; with -nocrop and -sgm_amyg_hipp) on the T1w image, writes the 5TT image and binarizes its cortical GM, WM and CSF volumes into separate masks. Use it to prepare ACT/5TT inputs for MRtrix3 tracking. Set premask to true if the T1 is already skull-stripped; for a FreeSurfer-based segmentation use the hsvs App.

inputs.description: T1-weighted anatomical image to segment into five tissue types.

outputs.description: 5TT image (mask.nii.gz) plus binarized gray matter (gm.nii.gz), white matter (wm.nii.gz) and CSF (csf.nii.gz) masks extracted from its volumes.

parameters.description: If the T1 has been skull-stripped before this step, set this to "true" (passes -premasked to 5ttgen fsl). Otherwise you risk losing significant portions of the brain.

citations.text: Smith RE, Tournier J-D, Calamante F, Connelly A. Anatomically-constrained tractography: Improved diffusion MRI streamlines tractography through effective use of anatomical information. NeuroImage 62:1924-1938 (2012).

failure_modes.cause: The CSF mask was not produced, so 5ttgen or mrconvert failed.
failure_modes.fix: Check the log for the 5ttgen error; for skull-stripped T1 images set premask to true.
